treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Consultation
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough examination, including full records, CBCT scans, and detailed photography, to accurately assess your oral health and understand your unique needs for full mouth restoration.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Treatment Plan
treatmentJourney.description: We collaborate with you to develop a personalized digital treatment plan, including mockups of your final smile and bite, ensuring your vision is incorporated into the design.

treatmentJourney.title: Foundation Phase
treatmentJourney.description: This stage involves any necessary preparatory work, such as extractions, implant placement, and gum or bone work, establishing a stable foundation for your new restorations.

treatmentJourney.title: Provisional Restorations
treatmentJourney.description: You'll receive temporary restorations to test the aesthetics, function, and bite, allowing for adjustments and ensuring comfort before permanent prosthetics are created.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Restoration Delivery
treatmentJourney.description: Our lab-crafted, permanent restorations are meticulously fabricated and then delivered, providing you with a beautiful, durable, and fully functional new smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Long-Term Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: We establish a comprehensive long-term care plan, including custom nightguards, regular hygiene visits, and protective measures to ensure the longevity and health of your new restorations.

faqItems.question: How long does a full mouth restoration take?
faqItems.answer: The duration of a full mouth restoration varies greatly depending on the complexity of your case and the specific treatments involved. Dr. Helley will provide a detailed timeline during your comprehensive consultation, ensuring you understand each step.

faqItems.question: How much does full mouth reconstruction cost?
faqItems.answer: The cost of full mouth reconstruction is highly individualized, based on the specific procedures needed to restore your smile and function. We will discuss all financial aspects and help you explore solutions during your visit.

faqItems.question: Why do I need a prosthodontist instead of a general dentist for complex cases?
faqItems.answer: A prosthodontist is a dental specialist trained in the replacement of missing teeth and the restoration of natural teeth. Dr. Helley's advanced training allows him to handle complex full-mouth rehabilitation cases that go beyond the scope of general dentistry, ensuring optimal outcomes.

faqItems.question: Will I have to be without teeth at any point during treatment?
faqItems.answer: Dr. Helley strives to ensure you are never without teeth during your full mouth restoration process. Provisional restorations are often used to maintain aesthetics and function while your permanent restorations are being crafted.

faqItems.question: How do you handle TMJ pain and bite issues?
faqItems.answer: Restoring proper bite alignment is a foundational aspect of full mouth reconstruction. Dr. Helley is a specialist in this area, focusing on creating a balanced bite to alleviate TMJ pain and improve overall oral comfort and function.

faqItems.question: Do you offer sedation for long appointments?
faqItems.answer: The comfort of our patients is paramount, especially during longer appointments often associated with full mouth restorations. Please discuss your concerns about dental anxiety with us, and we will explore options to make your experience as comfortable as possible.

doctor.name: Dr. Chris Helley
doctor.bio: Dr. Chris Helley is Bozeman's leading dentist and the only licensed Prosthodontist in the Gallatin Valley. He specializes in the replacement of missing teeth and related oral structures using crowns, bridges, implants, partial, and full dentures. A trained specialist in aesthetic, restorative, and implant dentistry, Dr. Helley offers solutions for complex full-mouth rehabilitation cases as well as single-tooth replacement. Known for his unwavering skill in creating long-lasting, comfortable, and beautiful dental restorations, he is a perfectionist committed to his craft, ensuring patients receive the absolute best service available.

reviews.name: Allen P.
reviews.text: Dr. Helley, along with his teammates, Ashley and Kara did a phenomenal job restoring my upper anterior teeth with crowns and veneers. I had prior trauma to the front tooth resulting in discoloration and the need for root canal therapy. Not only was each visit enjoyable, but the results are amazing. I couldn’t be happier with my new smile.

reviews.name: Hailey K.
reviews.text: I went to Rethink Dentistry to receive my bi annual cleaning after finding them online. Summer was great! Chris (Dr. Helley) did my cleaning and x-rays. He was fast, knowledgeable, and very gentle. He was very thorough throughout my visit. I recommend going to Rethink dentistry, it was the best dental cleaning I have ever received.

reviews.name: Anastasia D.
reviews.text: We’ve been to dentists all over the US and in Europe and this has been one of our best experiences yet! Dr. Helley would definitely be our primary dentist if we lived in the area. Gentle, thorough hygienist. Everyone super kind and friendly. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Cindy O.
reviews.text: While vacationing, one of my gold onlays popped off. Dr Helley was the only dentist that was able to get me in quickly that same day. My background is in dentistry, and I gave Dr. Helley highest marks for congeniality, knowledge, technical skill and a wonderfully caring attitude. His facility is immaculate and comfortable.

reviews.name: Michael S.
reviews.text: Dr. Helley completely transformed my smile and my ability to chew. The full mouth restoration process was handled with such precision and care, and the final results exceeded all my expectations. Truly a master of his craft!

reviews.name: Jessica L.
reviews.text: I had multiple failing restorations and was worried about the complexity of treatment. Dr. Helley's expertise as a prosthodontist gave me immense confidence. The team was incredibly supportive, and I now have a beautiful, functional smile.
